limitations: Dense test metrics are not retained for every simulation. Saved episode_average records and the unchanged verified producer establish the 48-time average; the saved trial-zero trajectory independently verifies it for mean, mode and isotropic mean.
GREAT receives measured velocities and rotations; conditional estimators additionally receive the known applied inputs.

saved_story.scope: Existing saved trajectory only; no new data or posterior moment integration.

snapshot.integration_rule: Independent 256-point Gauss-Legendre by 512-angle spectral-frame sphere quadrature; normalized invariant measure

retained_static_response_variance.interpretation: Posterior response variance under each displayed law; not an empirical loss under one shared law.

retained_information.interpretation: The retained p_z and the new p_Z denote the same candidate-plane conditional measurement law, with z=vec(Z).
